month.eyebrow: how it works, told as a story
month.title: A month with Trakeo
month.subtitle: Follow one month of someone's money, from signing up to knowing exactly where it all went.

0.title: Sign up
0.body: You create an account in about a minute. Trakeo never asks for your bank login: you name your first account and pick a currency.
0.note:
no bank login.
that's a promise.

1.title: Payday
1.body: Your salary arrives and you log it. First income of the month, done.

6.title: Rent in korunas
6.body: You move {amount} to your Czech account to pay rent, and enter the rate your bank actually gave you. Both balances match your bank's, not an estimate.

14.title: Budget check
14.body: Groceries and a weekend away bring you to {percent} of your monthly budget, and the bar turns yellow before you overspend, not after.

22.title: Import from your bank
22.body: You download last month's statement as a CSV from your bank's website and import it in one go. Your bank never talks to Trakeo.

30.title: Where did it go?
30.body: The month closes and the breakdown answers it in one look.

who.note:
which one are you?

personal.title: Personal Finance
personal.body: Keep track of your daily expenses and monthly subscriptions.

freelancers.title: Freelancers
freelancers.body: Manage business expenses and separate them from personal spending.

travelers.title: Travelers
travelers.body: Track spending in multiple currencies while on the go.

faq.title: Good questions
faq.note: anything else? the feedback button is always in the corner.

free.a: Yes. There are no ads and no payment step: you never enter a card. The free plan covers up to 10 transactions a day.

bank.q: Do I have to connect my bank?
bank.a: No. Trakeo never asks for your bank login. You add transactions yourself, or download a CSV statement from your bank and import it (Beta).

currencies.a: EUR, CZK, USD, GBP, PLN and CHF. You can hold accounts in any of them and move money between them.

rates.q: Which exchange rate does Trakeo use?
rates.a: The one your bank gave you. When you move money between currencies, you enter the rate you actually got, so your balances always match your bank's. Trakeo also keeps the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, as a guide and to estimate your total wealth across all your accounts in one currency.

tracking.a: No. There are no third-party analytics or advertising scripts on Trakeo.

languages.q: Which languages is it available in?
languages.a: English, Español and Čeština. You can switch at any time from the top bar.
